The provided text aligns closely with the conventions of the supernatural detective or occult thriller genre. The narrative employs classic tropes associated with this genre, such as a seasoned investigator (Detective Sarah) confronting a crime scene that defies ordinary explanation. The description of the "overwhelming aroma of incense" masking the "scent of death" establishes a sensory-rich atmosphere typical of noir or mystery fiction, while the mention of "ritualistic killing" and "ancient and long forgotten" symbols directly invokes the occult theme. The protagonist's internal reaction—being "chilled to the bone"—further emphasizes the supernatural or eerie stakes, distinguishing it from a standard police procedural. The text deviates from pure realism by introducing elements that require knowledge of "occult history," thereby shifting the focus from forensic science to mystical or historical investigation, which is a hallmark of the supernatural mystery subgenre.
